title: STRONG CONFIDENCE
FOR YOUR HOME
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp light on an open leather bible on a wooden table
gentle morning sunlight streaming through a kitchen window
soft golden light illuminating olive branches in a ceramic vase
peaceful rolling hills at dusk through a rustic window frame
quiet home interior with soft shadows and glowing hearth
empty wooden dining table with a steaming cup of tea

scenes.a: If you are bracing yourself for a difficult conversation within your home, listen to this.
Heavenly Father, we bring our household before You, seeking Your wisdom to anchor our hearts.
In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
May this confidence define how we speak to one another and how we face our fears.
Let our home be a sanctuary where Your peace dwells, sheltering every soul beneath Your grace.
We rest in You, trusting that You hold our future and protect our quiet dwelling place.
